verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Consensus offers Deep Search and a research agent that chains search tools, but nothing documents a job that keeps running unattended in the background or notifies the user when results are ready. Deep Search being more comprehensive is a related feature, not this capability, so the verdict stays at none.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can start a long research job that keeps working unattended and notifies me when the result is ready
